verdict.rationale: Mercury's product docs explicitly state receipts can be emailed or uploaded and are auto-attached to the correct card transaction with no manual effort, directly matching the story, and this is corroborated by an API endpoint for uploading transaction attachments and metadata. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user confirmation of the auto-matching accuracy and no detail on edge cases (e.g., ambiguous matches or multi-currency receipts).
